audit.whatIsWrong: The page has no cooldown numbers for the spikes it names.
audit.why: Twilight Shroud is 20/19/18/17/16s and Perfect Execution is 120/90/60s — her level-6 threat halves in cost by rank 2, which is what makes the mid game dangerous.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two errors. (a) 'passive healing' and 'her Q sustain' — Akali has no heal anywhere in her kit; the passive is Assassin's Mark, an empowered attack with bonus range, and no heal flag exists on any ability. (b) The page treats Twilight Shroud as immunity. Riot's text says she is 'unable to be selected by enemy spells and attacks' — untargetable, not untouchable.
audit.why: Mortal Steel and Spirit Cleave are non-targeted line/cone abilities, so they still damage and still reveal her inside the shroud. Fate Sealed does require a target and genuinely cannot fire into it. That distinction is the whole matchup and the page never states it.
audit.corrected: Healing claims removed and replaced with her real limiter (energy: 110 per Q at rank 1); shroud rewritten as untargetable-not-immune, with Fate Sealed named as the one thing it does blank.

edits.before: Akali's Q (Five Point Strike) poke plus passive-empowered auto out-damages your early trades, and her E (Shuriken Flip) can catch you if you overextend. At level 3 you can contest with your Q dashes, but she still wins raw trades through her Q sustain.
edits.after: Akali's Q (Five Point Strike) pokes from 550 range and her passive ring empowers the next auto with bonus range — that beats your early trades, and Shuriken Flip (E) catches you if you overextend. She has no lane sustain; energy is her limit, so bait her into spending it.

edits.before: Akali controls the early game: her Q (Five Point Strike) both pokes you and heals her via passive, so she wins the short trades your Q dashes want to start. Levels 1-2 you simply can't out-damage her sustain — focus on last-hitting and don't walk into her Q range for free. Her energy pool lets her poke repeatedly, so trading auto-for-auto is a losing exchange this early.
edits.after: Akali controls the early game: Five Point Strike pokes from 550 range and her passive ring empowers the follow-up auto, so she wins the short trades your Q dashes want to start. She has no healing in lane — energy is what stops her, and at rank 1 that Q costs 110, so bait two casts and the poke goes quiet. Until then last-hit and stay outside her Q range.

edits.before: Level 3 gives you an even footing if you play it perfectly — your Q mobility can dodge her Q and let you trade back — but she re-tilts it at 4-5 and again at 6. Perfect Execution's two dashes and execute make her a genuine kill threat, and W shroud lets her break your target-lock and vanish mid-trade. Hold your E to answer her R dashes rather than burning it to engage.
edits.after: Level 3 gives you an even footing if you play it perfectly — your Q mobility dodges her Q and lets you trade back — but she re-tilts it at 4-5 and again at 6. Perfect Execution's two dashes and execute make her a genuine kill threat. Twilight Shroud only blanks targeted spells: Mortal Steel and Spirit Cleave still hit her inside it, so keep swinging instead of backing off.

notes: The 'passive healing' / 'Q sustain' line was a fabrication — nothing in Akali's kit heals. Packet flagged 'Perfect Execution's' in mid as a suspect name; it is correct and was left alone. Packet also flags the chart as contradicting a 52.92% win rate; I only corrected the two rows that additionally contradicted their own why text (level 1 and Two+ items), because the akali__yone mirror was already audited and I could not see its chart in mirrorFindings.
